candidate.answerReason: 35 has 3 tens and 5 ones; subtracting 30 removes the 3 tens and leaves 5.

methods.label: Removing the tens
methods.explanation: 35 has 3 tens and 5 ones. Subtracting 30 removes the 3 tens, leaving 5 ones, so \(35-30=5\).
methods.levelReason: The method uses Grade 1 place value to subtract a multiple of ten mentally.
